newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Slovenia names arrangers for DM50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Slovenia names arrangers for DM50 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, Nov 18 (LPC) - The Republic of Slovenia has mandated Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Bankgesellschaft Berlin to arrange a 50 million mark term loan, according to a banker close to the deal.
The seven year and one day credit is priced at 22.5 bps over LIBOR, decreasing to 15 bps should Slovenia become a member of the OECD. The loan has a bullet repayment.
Syndication will be launched shortly and will be offered mostly to banks which bid previously for the mandate.
In March, Slovenia completed a $60 million, seven-year term loan initially priced 40 bps over LIBOR.
